author: Cleo Abram
description:
If you dove into the sun, the first layer you’d hit is hot enough to make diamonds BOIL. 

Right now we’re in a golden age of new solar science. For the first time, we’re getting close-up pictures of the Sun like we’ve never seen. Sending probes into its atmosphere. And revealing secrets about our star we never thought possible… 

Trust me, after this video, you’ll never look up at the sun the same way. 

So let me take you on a journey… INTO THE SUN.

This episode was made possible by AT&T, the official connectivity partner of HUGE* If True.
